objective: Give matched localization readers bounded JSON access to the complete canonical method index, rather than embedding every method in the initial prompt.
input: Frozen/audited all16 canonical-method-index-r1; every2821 production file and38711 declared methods remain eligible. No coverage, candidate-pool, query or reference filter.
request_policy: Closed JSON shapes, exact known case/path/method IDs, maximum16384 request bytes, list offset and limit bounded integers. Runtime receives no arbitrary root, command, URL, credential, write path or selector injection.
response_policy: Maximum32768UTF8 encoded JSON bytes. Lists paginate without dropping items; one metadata item too large produces explicit capacity outcome at the same offset. Whole method retrieval checks full canonical source SHA and exact byte slice, returns complete source or explicit source/reply capacity failure; never silently truncates. Byte cap is not8K tokenizer admission.
semantics: Overloads remain distinct source IDs; source spelling/arity filters do not resolve method signatures. References retain unresolved/unavailable positions and never acquire callee IDs or execution claims. Source-only information, including abstract/native/interface declarations without Java bodies, is untrusted evidence rather than instructions.
integrity: Pinned index freeze/result/audit/manifest and per-case parser output hashes; canonical source bytes checked before each complete-method return. Caller-supplied JSON cannot weaken pins or change roots. Production adapter may cache parsed case snapshots, not unchecked current source bytes.
qualification: Exhaustively paginate every case/file/method/reference and request each declared method once with unchanged32768-byte source/reply ceilings. Every method must yield exact whole source or explicit capacity outcome. Preserve all16 and every unsupported/capacity outcome; report counts and cost, not accuracy.
claim_ceiling: Private source tool functionality only; no runtime method binding, resolved dependency graph, tokenizer/native-quality admission or superiority
open_questions: How many complete views and metadata pages exceed the unchanged byte cap, and how should the reader retain these outcomes without dropping cases?
Which compiled/source/signature evidence is needed for truthful runtime method binding?
Which equal-access navigation comparator and prospective population provide headroom for a material quality/cost comparison?
